title: tests.py given only test files still records its run as mode full
goal: tests.py writes a run that names only test files with a file-scoped mode, not mode full, so a reader of test.run rows with mode full sees only real full runs; the module docstring (tests.py:16-25) names the named-files run among the runs that take no lock and record no file times; a test plants a path argument and reads the recorded mode; found by the SP-3siaqxdf review of BG-tm3g5pha (tests.py main's record_run call)

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import tests;got=[];tests.run_pytest=lambda a,report=None:0;tests.wants_host_lock=lambda a:False;tests.record_run=lambda mode,*r:got.append(mode);tests.main(['_tools/test_tests_lock.py']);assert got and got[0]!='full', 'a named-file run is recorded as mode '+str(got)
